rows.ja: 旧親会社・提携カード
フランチャイズ加盟先
競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: 旧親会社。分離時にWyndham Hotelsと各種契約(ライセンス・非競業など)を結んだ
relations.text_en: Former parent; signed several agreements with Wyndham Hotels at the spin-off, including license and non-compete terms

source.label: Travel & Leisure 10-K(2025年提出)
source.quote: In connection with the Spin-off, we entered into certain agreements with Wyndham Hotels.

relations.text: Wyndham Hotelsとの提携カード契約を延長
relations.text_en: Extended its co-brand partnership agreement with Wyndham Hotels & Resorts

source.label: Barclays 年次報告(20-F)(2026年提出)
source.quote: We also extended our current partnership agreements with Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, Upromise and our cruise line partners

companies.name: ラックスアーバン・ホテルズ
companies.sub: ホテルの一括賃借・運営

relations.text: 2023年8月、運営ホテルをWyndhamブランドに加えるフランチャイズ契約を締結
relations.text_en: Signed franchise agreements in August 2023 to bring its hotels into Wyndham brands

source.label: Luxurban Hotels 10-Q/A(2024年8月)
source.quote: In August 2023, the Company entered into franchise agreements with Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, Inc.

relations.text: Hiltonが10-Kで、主な競合としてWyndhamを挙げる
relations.text_en: Hilton names Wyndham among its primary competitors

source.label: Hilton Worldwide 10-K(2026年提出)
source.quote: our primary competitors are Accor S.A., Choice Hotels International, Hyatt Hotels Corporation, Intercontinental Hotel Group, Marriott International and Wyndham Hotels & Resorts.

relations.text: Marriottが10-Kで、競合の有力ブランドとしてWyndhamを挙げる
relations.text_en: Marriott names Wyndham among strong-brand competitors

source.label: Marriott International 10-K(2025年提出)
source.quote: we compete against many other companies with strong brands and guest appeal, including Hilton, IHG Hotels & Resorts, Hyatt, Wyndham Hotels & Resorts

relations.text: Choiceの役員契約で、競合先の一社としてWyndhamを挙げる
relations.text_en: A Choice executive agreement lists Wyndham as a competitor

source.label: Choice Hotels International 10-K(2026年提出)
source.quote: Wyndham Hotel Group, LLC aka Wyndham Hotels & Resorts

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
